title: Credential
description: Reference to a secret used by a provider or integration. The secret itself is write-only and never returned by the API.

provider.description: Provider id this credential belongs to (see provider.json).

key.description: Storage or environment key holding the secret, e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

value.description: Secret material. Write-only; stripped from every response and log.

scopes.description: Granted scopes for oauth and token credentials.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds; omitted when the credential never expires.

rotated_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last rotation.
